_comment: Per-tax-year figures the W-2 Box 1 / Box 3 / Box 5 reconciliation needs. Two years are carried on purpose: a W-2 is read in January for the year that just ended, so the page has to answer for the prior year as well as the current one. ANNUAL REFRESH: when SSA announces the next year's COLA (mid-October), add the new year here with its own sourceUrl and publishedDate. The current year's wage base is ALSO carried in src/data/tax-data-2026.json (federal.fica.socialSecurity.wageBase) for the paycheck engine; build.js asserts the two agree and throws if they drift.
